summary_en: 43,691 TENPOS shares (0.31% of S/O) to be issued via simplified stock exchange to acquire Tomi Beauty as wholly-owned subsidiary. Exchange ratio 1 TENPOS : 14.564 Tomi Beauty shares. Effective 2026-08-27. All consideration shares from TENPOS treasury. No shareholder approval required for TENPOS (simplified procedure under Company Law Article 796(2)).
title_en: Notice of Stock Exchange (Simplified Stock Exchange) for Complete Subsidiary Status of Tomi Beauty Co., Ltd. (currently Tomi Beauty Co., Ltd. as a Special Limited Company) by TENPOS Holdings Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: TENPOS Holdings announced on 2026-07-08 that its board has approved a simplified stock exchange to acquire Tomi Beauty Co., Ltd. as a wholly-owned subsidiary, effective 2026-08-27 (planned). The exchange ratio is 1 TENPOS share : 14.564 Tomi Beauty shares. TENPOS will issue 43,691 ordinary shares (0.31% of issued capital ex-treasury) in aggregate consideration, all from existing treasury holdings. Tomi Beauty (currently a special limited company, to be converted to a joint-stock company in early August 2026) will become TENPOS's wholly-owned subsidiary. The exchange proceeds under the simplified procedure of the Company Law Article 796(2), requiring no TENPOS shareholder vote; Tomi Beauty shareholders will approve via deemed written resolution under Article 319(1). The rationale is to expand TENPOS's beauty segment, initiated in 2025 with the establishment of Salon Graph, by leveraging Tomi Beauty's high retail margins, customer base, and staff expertise to strengthen sales and profitability. An independent third-party valuation firm (tax attorney firm Tomoni) performed a simplified fairness opinion on the exchange ratio. Fractional shares will be settled in cash per Company Law Article 234.
